title: MIDI input conditions Suno generation
summary: Suno documents MIDI score uploads in Simple Create to guide notes, with text instructions guiding the arrangement. Desktop plan restrictions are documented; MCP capabilities must be probed separately.

build.target: Submit an original MIDI melody through the official supported Suno workflow and measure whether generated audio preserves its motif.
requires: Authenticated official Suno MCP with user-granted MIDI upload and generation
Supported MIDI conditioning model (observed ChatGPT interface: v6-wild in Simple mode)
Operator-approved credits and original content rights
inputs: Original valid .mid score under provider upload limit
Musical instrumentation/feel description and full generation settings
outputs: MIDI upload ID and completed Suno clip IDs
Source MIDI hash, clip/analysis receipt and observed fidelity
execute: Verify real account grants, model label, upload size and copyright ownership before spending.
Upload the original MIDI using discovered official methods; finish any staged upload.
Use the provider's supported Simple-mode MIDI-conditioned generation, avoiding incompatible custom lyrics/style.
Poll asynchronous generation and capture clip IDs without fabricating success or duration.
Compare identifiable intervals and phrase boundaries to source score; collect blinded listener judgment.

applies_when: An original melody already exists and a rendered arrangement is desired.
The client advertises official MIDI conditioning and the account has required grants.
avoid_when: Suno MIDI grant or required model is unavailable.
No rights or budget to submit the score.

operator: Verify model and tool contract at runtime; do not assume ChatGPT connector grants transfer.
Approve maximum credits and candidate count first; no automatic paid retry.

stop_when: A finished linked clip and fidelity assessment are recorded, or a precise permission/upload error ends work.
Do not claim exact MIDI adherence from provider job completion alone.

checks: Record source MIDI hash, tool parameters, provider statuses and final clip IDs.
Use independent musical and listener checks, including failed notes and skipped conditions.
